target.title: fix(ci): export external preflight drift controls
target.body:
## Summary

- export the documented external-preflight heartbeat and moving-main bounds into the execute job
- run exact-merge Codex review without bubblewrap on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu, where `read-only` fails before command execution
- preserve the hard boundary: the review subprocess receives no GitHub/API token and tracked checkout bytes, tree, parent, and Git config are verified afterward
- assert all workflow defaults in the preflight integration test

## Production evidence

- run https://github.com/openclaw/clownfish/actions/runs/28831300020 reached exact-head validation but blocked because Codex `read-only` sandbox failed on `bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted`

## Validation

- `node --test --test-name-pattern "^external merge preflight is exact-head, read-only, and refuses unresolved review evidence$" test/preflight-external-pr-merge.test.mjs`
- `git diff --check`
